name: record-a-goose-sighting
description: A fictional government service that intentionally contains accessibility problems, built as a static site for accessibility training

scripts.build: npm run build:goose && npm run build:lab
scripts.build:lab: vite build --config vite.config.mjs && node scripts/lab-manifest.mjs && node scripts/lab-catalogue.mjs && node scripts/act-upstream.mjs && node scripts/merge-lab.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run build && BROWSERS=all playwright test
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test
